title: Air Force News: Hurricane Hunters Hawaii
description: Package of members of the 53rd Reconnaissance Squadron "Hurricane Hunters" working from Hawaii after receiving the call that Hurricane Felicia was threatening the Islands. Produced by Nick Tovo.
